vocab.simpleEn: something that limits what you can do
vocab.simpleZh: 限制你能做什么的因素。
vocab.exampleEn: Time is the biggest constraint for many working learners.
vocab.exampleZh: 时间是很多在职学习者最大的限制。
vocab.upgradeEn: Use constraint when explaining why a plan is difficult.
vocab.upgradeZh: 解释计划为什么难时，可以用 constraint。

cycle.summaryEn: Answer short questions clearly and without too many pauses.
cycle.summaryZh: 练习简短清楚地回答，不要卡太久。

frame.useEn: Use in graph and chart descriptions.
frame.useZh: 适合图表描述和趋势题。

meaningEn: This writing word helps Becky build stronger IELTS paragraphs and ideas.
meaningZh: 这个写作词可以帮助 Becky 写出更强的雅思段落和观点。
promptEn: China drill: read the Chinese meaning, shadow the example twice, then make one Becky-style sentence with "constraint" using The overall trend is...
promptZh: 中文母语者练法：先看中文意思，跟读例句两遍，再用 "constraint" 和 总体趋势是... 写一句 Becky 自己的话。
sourceEn: This harder word is auto-picked for Becky and refreshes every day with a China-friendly output drill.
sourceZh: 这个高分词会每天自动为 Becky 刷新，并配中文母语者适用的输出练习。
